title: Claude Code SKILL.md frontmatter
description: Contract for the YAML frontmatter of a SKILL.md file. Mirrors the official Claude Code skill spec as documented in CLAUDE.md (Required + Optional field tables). This schema is the machine-readable source of truth; the CLAUDE.md tables remain the human-readable view. Adding a new official Claude Code frontmatter field requires adding it here too — additionalProperties is false so unknown keys (typos, stale fields) are rejected.

name.description: Skill identifier. Must match the directory name. Lowercase kebab-case.

description.description: One-line summary, verb-first, ending with a period. Mirrored verbatim in the skill README line 3 and the root README skills table.

allowed-tools.description: Comma-separated list of tool names the skill may use. Each token is a tool name (e.g. Read, Grep, Agent, EnterPlanMode).

model.description: Model override for the skill turn.

effort.description: Effort level for the skill turn.

argument-hint.description: Autocomplete hint shown after the slash command (e.g. "[path | identifier]").

arguments.description: Named positional arguments enabling $name substitution in the body.

when_to_use.description: Trigger-phrase guidance for auto-invocation. Appended to description in the skill listing (counts toward the 1,536-character listing cap).

paths.description: Glob patterns that auto-activate the skill when matching files are in context.

disable-model-invocation.description: When true, the skill is strictly user-triggered (does not block Agent-tool subagents).

user-invocable.description: When false, hides the skill from the / menu (background-knowledge skills only Claude invokes).

context.description: Set to fork to run the skill in a forked subagent context (body becomes the subagent prompt).

agent.description: Subagent type to use when context: fork is set (e.g. Explore, Plan, general-purpose, or a custom agent).

shell.description: Shell used for !`command` dynamic context injection blocks.

takes-arg.description: Deprecated repo-internal field, never recognized by Claude Code. Use argument-hint instead. Allowed here only so legacy forks fail schema validation softly (lint.sh emits a separate migration warning).
